title: 第27章 出人头地
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
柴门口，静了一瞬。

    还是罗长庚先回过神来。

    他扶着桌沿，撑着那条伤腰，就要起身见礼。

    张乡老抬手，虚按了按：

    “坐着，坐着。自家村里，讲究这些虚礼做什么。”

    话是这么说，那只手却受了这半个礼，才落下去。

    罗影搬了条凳子过来，罗川闷声进了灶屋，舀了一碗白水端出来。

    家里没有茶。

    张乡老迈进院子，目光不动声色地扫了一圈。

    缺了角的院墙，空荡荡的灶屋，桌上三只见了底的粗碗。

    他在凳子上坐下了。

    坐得四平八稳。

    “长庚啊。”

    “吃过了？”

    “路过，顺脚进来坐坐。”

    罗影立在一旁，垂着眼。

    这个时辰的稻花村，没有顺脚的路。

    张乡老端起那只缺了口的粗碗，抿了一口白水，放下了。

    “今儿村口那一出，我在自家门楼上，瞧着了。”

    “【追风驹】呐。”

    他顿了顿，目光落在罗影身上，从头到脚，量了一遍。

    “县学的先生，肯这么抬举一个娃。稻花村，几十年没这光景了。”

    罗长庚搓了搓手：

    “娃还小，当不起先生们错爱……”

    “当得起当不起，先生们心里有杆秤。”

    张乡老抬手，把这话截住了。

    语气不重，却没给人接话的缝。

    他把那只篮子，往桌上一放，揭开了蓝布。

    一刀腊肉，十几个鸡蛋，一小包红糖。

    蓝布揭开的那一刻，罗川的喉结，不由自主地滚了一下。

    那一刀腊肉，油亮亮的。

    罗家的灶上，这股味儿，断了快半年了。

    他垂下眼，把这点失态掩了过去。

    “几样吃食，不值什么。”

    “给影子补补身子。念书的营生，费脑子。”

    罗长庚的手在膝盖上按了按，欠了欠身：

    “使不得，乡老，这……”

    “长庚，你别推。”

    张乡老摆摆手：

    “这一份，算村里的。”

    “稻花村几十年，才供出这么一棵考县学的苗。村里人脸上，都沾光。”

    “你，替村里收着。”

    罗长庚的嘴唇动了动，到底没再推。

    那双布满老茧的手，把篮子往桌里挪了挪，挪得很轻。

    张乡老又端起碗，抿了口水。

    他的眼角，把这个家徒四壁的院子，又量了一遍。

    半个月前，他还断定，这家子是把一条命，押在了一场空想上。

    可今日村口那匹追风驹，那句“教习白请的”，他在门楼上听得真真的。

    县学先生的脸面值多少头牛，他张某人这把算盘，还拨得动。

    放下碗，他像是才想起什么似的，从怀里摸出一串铜钱，搁在了桌上。

    铜钱压着木桌，一声闷响。

    “还有一桩正账，顺道结了。”

    “前日，川哥儿来租牛。原说的，是三个月，一两整。”
content_en:
Chai Menmen was silent for a moment.

It was Luo Changgeng who came to his senses first.

He held the edge of the table, supported his injured waist, and was about to stand up to greet him.

Mr. Zhang Xiang raised his hand and pressed it:

"Sit, sit. In my village, what are these false etiquettes?"

Having said that, the hand received this half salute before falling down.

Luo Ying brought a stool over, and Luo Chuan entered the kitchen room in a muffled voice, scooped out a bowl of water and brought it out.

There is no tea at home.

Zhang Xiang walked into the courtyard and glanced around calmly.

A corner of the courtyard wall was missing, the kitchen was empty, and there were three thick bowls with bottoms on the table.

He sat down on the stool.

Sit still and steady.

"Chang Geng."

"Have you eaten?"

"Passing by, come in and sit down."

Luo Ying stood aside, eyes lowered.

There is no smooth road in Daohua Village at this time.

Zhang Xianglao picked up the thick bowl with the mouth missing, took a sip of water, and put it down.

"As soon as the village entrance came out today, I was watching from the gate of my house."

"[Chasing the Wind Horse] Na."

He paused, his eyes fell on Luo Ying, and measured him from head to toe.

"The gentleman from the county school is willing to praise a child like this. Daohua Village has not seen this situation in decades."

Luo Changgeng rubbed his hands:

"The baby is still young and cannot afford the wrong love from gentlemen..."

"Whether you deserve it or not, gentlemen have a strong balance in their minds."

Zhang Xianglao raised his hand to stop these words.

The tone was not serious, but there was no room for anyone to answer the question.

He put the basket on the table and uncovered the blue cloth.

A knife of bacon, a dozen eggs, and a small packet of brown sugar.

The moment the blue cloth was unveiled, Luo Chuan's Adam's apple rolled involuntarily.

That knife of bacon was shiny.

The smell on the Luo family's stove has been gone for almost half a year.

He lowered his eyes to cover up this faux pas.

"A few kinds of food are not worth much."

"To replenish the shadow's health. Studying for a living is a waste of brains."

Luo Changgeng pressed his hands on his knees and bowed:

"I can't do it, old man, this..."

"Chang Geng, don't push me."

Mr. Zhang Xiang waved his hand:

"This share belongs to the village."

"It took decades for Daohua Village to produce such a seedling that passed the county school exam. Everyone in the village was proud of it."

"You, keep it for the village."

Luo Changgeng's lips moved, but he didn't push anymore.

Those calloused hands moved the basket to the table very gently.

Mr. Zhang Xiang picked up the bowl again and took a sip of water.

From the corner of his eyes, he took another look at the courtyard with its bare walls.

Half a month ago, he concluded that this family was betting their lives on a fantasy.

But today, he heard the words of the horse chasing the wind at the entrance of the village: "It's free to teach you". He really heard it on the gate.

Mr. County School's face is worth as much as a cow, and he can still move Zhang's abacus.

Putting down the bowl, he took out a bunch of copper coins from his arms and placed them on the table, as if he had just remembered something.

The copper coins pressed against the wooden table, making a muffled sound.

"There is also a serious matter, which I will settle by the way."

"Brother Chuan came to rent cows the day before yesterday. I said it was three months, one or two whole months."
